monogamous.name: Monogamous
monogamous.desc: One exclusive partner at a time.

civil_union.name: Civil union
civil_union.desc: A legally recognized partnership without a formal marriage.

long_distance.name: Long-distance
long_distance.desc: A committed couple separated by geography.

open_relationship.name: Open relationship
open_relationship.desc: A primary couple who agree to additional partners.

polyamorous.name: Polyamorous
polyamorous.desc: Several loving relationships maintained openly and at once.

companionate.name: Companionate
companionate.desc: Deep affection and partnership with little or no passion.

throuple.name: Throuple
throuple.desc: A committed relationship between three people.

arranged_marriage.name: Arranged marriage
arranged_marriage.desc: A union arranged by families rather than chosen by the couple.

portland_polycule.name: Portland Polycule
portland_polycule.desc: A sprawling, densely interconnected network of polyamorous partners, metamours and their exes, all somehow still on good terms.

serial_monogamy.name: Serial monogamist
serial_monogamy.desc: One exclusive partner at a time, in a long string of relationships.

single_content.name: Contentedly single
single_content.desc: Not seeking a partner and at peace with it.

situationship.name: Situationship
situationship.desc: An undefined romantic entanglement that never quite becomes a relationship.

friends_with_benefits.name: Friends with benefits
friends_with_benefits.desc: Casual intimacy between friends with no romantic commitment.

queerplatonic.name: Queerplatonic partnership
queerplatonic.desc: A committed bond stronger than friendship but not romantic.

aromantic_solo.name: Aromantic solo
aromantic_solo.desc: Living by choice without any romantic partnership.

none.name: No tie
none.desc: They have no standing with each other beyond travelling together.

acquaintances.name: Acquaintances
acquaintances.desc: They know each other by name and little else.

friends.name: Friends
friends.desc: A settled friendship, tested and kept.

best_friends.name: Best friends
best_friends.desc: The first person each of them would call.

childhood_friends.name: Childhood friends
childhood_friends.desc: They grew up in the same streets and never lost touch.

comrades.name: Comrades in arms
comrades.desc: They fought on the same side and each owes the other a life.

partners.name: Partners
partners.desc: A romance both of them acknowledge.

spouses.name: Married
spouses.desc: Legally and openly bound to each other.

engaged.name: Engaged
engaged.desc: Promised to each other, with the date still to come.

lovers.name: Lovers
lovers.desc: A physical romance neither has put a name to.

situationship.name: Situationship
situationship.desc: Something is going on and neither will define it.

unaware.name: Unaware of their feelings
unaware.desc: The other one is in love; this one has never noticed.

twins.name: Twins
twins.desc: Born the same day, of the same womb.

child.name: Their child
child.desc: This one was raised by the other.

mentor.name: Their mentor
mentor.desc: This one taught the other the trade.

student.name: Their student
student.desc: This one learned the trade from the other.

rivals.name: Rivals
rivals.desc: A running contest neither of them will concede.
